Type: deco
Name: Pinzon Faux Fur Throw Blanket - 63 x 87 Inch, Frost Grey
Colors: Frost Grey
Materials: Polyester
Faux fur throw for sumptuous softness and a luxurious layer of cozy warmth About 1/2-inch thick on one side and velvety soft fabric on the reverse Made of 100% polyester; faux fur, so it’s animal friendly (no animals harmed) Individually dyed, creating natural variations in the color—no 2 are exactly the same Frost Grey color for neutral, yet sophisticated beauty; measures 63 by 87 inches Made in OEKO-TEX Standard 100 factory, an independent certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards.
